findings.title: ResilientConnectionManager uses non-existent /ws endpoint
findings.description: Client defaults to /ws WebSocket endpoint but server only has Socket.IO at /socket.io/
findings.recommendation: Change wsUrl default to /socket.io/ and use socket.io-client instead of raw WebSocket

findings.title: ResilientConnectionManager uses non-existent /api/events SSE endpoint
findings.description: Server has no SSE endpoint at /api/events - will infinitely fallback
findings.recommendation: Remove SSE fallback or implement SSE endpoint on server

findings.title: ResilientConnectionManager uses non-existent /api/poll polling endpoint
findings.description: Server has no polling endpoint at /api/poll - JSON parse errors on every poll
findings.recommendation: Remove polling fallback or implement polling endpoint

findings.title: ResilientConnectionManager does not use Socket.IO despite server using it
findings.description: Server uses Socket.IO at /socket.io/ but client uses raw WebSocket/SSE/polling
findings.recommendation: Rewrite ResilientConnectionManager to use socket.io-client with proper transports
findings.evidence: Server websocket-server.ts uses Socket.IO at path /socket.io/

findings.title: Missing SQLite database corruption detection and validation
findings.description: Corrupted OPFS/IndexedDB data silently falls back to in-memory without cleanup
findings.recommendation: Add isValidSQLiteDatabase(), validateDatabaseIntegrity(), and clearAllPersistedData() methods
findings.evidence: Lines 205-220: try/catch only checks "SELECT 1" but does not validate schema integrity

findings.title: No automatic cleanup of corrupted database files
findings.description: When corruption detected, corrupted data remains in OPFS/IndexedDB causing repeated failures
findings.recommendation: Add automatic cleanup of OPFS file and IndexedDB backup on corruption detection
findings.evidence: Line 215 sets existingData = null but does not delete persisted files

findings.title: No SQLite integrity checks on database load
findings.recommendation: Add PRAGMA integrity_check or PRAGMA quick_check after loading database

findings.title: Three uncoordinated sync mechanisms cause conflicts and duplicate work
findings.description: SyncManager (tRPC HTTP), useSyncWithWebSocket (broken ResilientConnectionManager), and useWebSocket (Socket.IO) all handle sync independently
findings.recommendation: Unify: 1) Delete useSyncWithWebSocket (deprecated), 2) Make SyncManager use Socket.IO for real-time + tRPC for batch, 3) Keep useWebSocket for UI notifications only
findings.evidence: All three files exist and have overlapping responsibilities

findings.title: SyncManager lacks real-time event integration
findings.description: SyncManager only uses tRPC HTTP polling, missing real-time updates via Socket.IO
findings.recommendation: Add Socket.IO listener in SyncManager to trigger incremental sync on realtime_event
findings.evidence: SyncManager only has startAutoSync() with setInterval, no event-driven sync

findings.title: Duplicate conflict resolution logic in multiple sync systems
findings.recommendation: Centralize conflict resolution in SyncManager, remove from useSyncWithWebSocket
findings.evidence: Both SyncManager and useSyncWithWebSocket handle version-based conflicts

findings.title: No database indexes on frequently queried columns
findings.description: Tables lack indexes on userId, updatedAt, clientId - full table scans on sync
findings.recommendation: Add indexes: userId, updatedAt, clientId on all sync tables
findings.evidence: No .index() calls found in drizzle schema files

findings.title: No bundle size analysis script
findings.recommendation: Add "analyze": "vite-bundle-analyzer" or "webpack-bundle-analyzer" to scripts
findings.evidence: No bundle analysis in package.json scripts

findings.title: No role-based sync permissions
findings.description: All users sync all tables regardless of role (farmer, agent, admin, cooperative)
findings.recommendation: Add role-based table access control in sync operations
findings.evidence: SyncManager syncs all 7 tables for every user
